column1: # Shape patches (ladder.rung121.shape.ShapePatches): edits of NeoForge 21.0 classes that give a 1.21.1 mod mixin its point
# (the converter applies them to the bottom jar it checks mixins against). Each class must be a target of ShapeTargetsMixin.
# 21.1 asks stack.supportsEnchantment(holder) at the anvil, enchant_randomly and /enchant (fabric's item API wraps those
# calls); 21.0 asks enchantment.canEnchant(stack). ItemStack gets the method, the three calls become it.
